Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>LSJ,
>
>Can SCS play Martyr´s Resilence? Preventing a damage to another minion!

Hmm...tough question.

Based on the precedent set by Infernal Familiar and Ian Forestal (neither of
which would allow the playing of a multi-discipline card if the minion has
neither of the disciplines), I'd have to venture a "no." But that's just me.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.
Card text allows SCS to use a card that requires "a" discipline as a vampire
with that Discipline. It doesn't grant the SCS two disciplines for cards that
require two, though.
